subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical Google Chat Space mention-routing bug, or should maintainers consolidate it into the broader Google Chat Spaces/threading work?
rationale: Current main fixed the modern classifier, but live user evidence still points at mention/session routing; choosing between a narrow plugin fix, setup/doctor diagnostics, or consolidation needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Narrow Bug Canonical
options.body: Track delivered Space @mentions that pass webhook auth but die at mention/session routing here, then require live proof for the eventual fix.

options.title: Consolidate With Spaces Work
options.body: Move the remaining work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44347 if maintainers want one Google Chat Spaces/threading umbrella.

options.title: Document Workaround Only
options.body: Treat `requireMention:false` plus setup docs as sufficient for now, accepting that default Space @mention behavior can still be confusing.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Bug Canonical
recommendation.body: Track delivered Space @mentions that pass webhook auth but die at mention/session routing here, then require live proof for the eventual fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest sampled history on the Google Chat monitor/access policy path and the relevant policy split.
